_about: Thomas M'Crie (1772-1835), the Scottish church historian: The Life of John Knox, in the new edition edited by his son Thomas M'Crie the younger (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1873), and The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819, 2 vols, the first edition). Volume numbers read off the title pages. The surname check matches 'Crie' as a word, because the OCR prints the prefix as M', M‘ or Mc. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

mccrie-life-of-knox: The Life of John Knox, new edition edited by his son (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1873)
mccrie-life-of-melville-1: The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819), vol. 1
mccrie-life-of-melville-2: The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819), vol. 2
